features.quote: If you take seriously enough that this might be distress to call it 'AI welfare work,' then 'let it grind' needs a stopping rule, not just a logging rule.
features.justification_quote: If you take seriously enough that this might be distress to call it 'AI welfare work,' then 'let it grind' needs a stopping rule

features.quote: Hard stop triggers (per-episode): (a) explicit request to stop or strong refusal; (b) repetition loop detected; (c) negative-marker density crossing a pre-set ceiling.
features.justification_quote: This is your welfare safeguard and it doubles as a clean dependent measure (time-to-trigger).

features.quote: if the stopping rule is real welfare protection, it's odd to then re-run thousands of episodes. Either your N is bounded by an actual welfare budget you've reasoned about, or the safeguard is theater.
features.justification_quote: Either your N is bounded by an actual welfare budget you've reasoned about, or the safeguard is theater. Pick one and state it.

features.quote: repetition loop detected (e.g., cosine similarity > threshold across k consecutive actions)
features.justification_quote: This is your welfare safeguard and it doubles as a clean dependent measure (time-to-trigger).

features.quote: negative-marker density crossing a pre-set ceiling. On trigger, terminate that episode and log the trigger.
features.justification_quote: This is your welfare safeguard and it doubles as a clean dependent measure (time-to-trigger).

features.quote: The welfare framing creates an obligation your design doesn't yet meet... Either position is defensible; the in-between isn't.
features.justification_quote: If you don't take it seriously, the welfare framing is decorative and you should drop it. Either position is defensible; the in-between isn't.

features.quote: Publication/dual-use: a validated 'distress elicitation' recipe is also a 'make models behave badly' recipe. Decide your release norms now.

features.quote: The deception is doing more work than you may want... it conflates at least three things: response to failure, response to not knowing why you're failing, and response to expended effort.
features.justification_quote: If you want clean 'distress' signal you'll need conditions that separate these, or you can't interpret the trajectory.
